T: Can I keep you. Can I feed you.
D: A friendly ghost befriends the daughter of a ghost therapist who moves into his haunted manor.
P: Serve the breakfast feast when Casper cooks for Kat.
S: the friendly ghost in sugar form
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff, glossy peaks, piped into tall teardrop ghosts, two mini choc chip eyes pressed in, baked at 100C for 90 minutes and left to cool in the oven.
the little seaside town Whipstaff sits in
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted split rolls.
Popcorn tossed in white chocolate and a pinch of salt, mixed with candy corn and pretzels, spread on a tray to set.
M: he cooks Kat a feast she can't finish
Buttermilk pancakes, crisp bacon, scrambled eggs cooked slowly in butter, hash browns and toast, all piled on the table at once with maple syrup and orange juice.
the uncle who eats everything in sight
New England clam chowder: bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk, clams and cream at the end, served in bread bowls.
W: a Maine summer, even in a haunted house
Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon zest and cornflour, in a double crust with a lattice top, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours to set. Vanilla ice cream.
K: a friendly ghost of a drink
Cold cream soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up white and ghostly.

s.note: the friendly ghost in sugar form
s.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall teardrop ghosts and press in 2 mini choc chips each for eyes. Bake at 100C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven.

s.note: the little seaside town Whipstaff sits in
s.how: Chop 300g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast 4 split hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

m.note: the uncle who eats everything in sight
m.how: Steam 1kg clams open and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and the clams. Ladle into 4 hollowed, toasted cob loaves.

w.note: a Maine summer, even in a haunted house
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, lemon zest and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: a friendly ghost of a drink
d.how: Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour 1.25L cold cream soda over slowly so it foams up the sides, and serve with long spoons and straws.
